name: Security Option 1
definition: Provides information about the CA security option.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the value is a debit or credit.

MinimumExercisableSecuritiesQuantity.name: Minimum Exercisable Securities Quantity
MinimumExercisableSecuritiesQuantity.definition: Minimum quantity of financial instrument or lot of rights/warrants that must be exercised.

MinimumExercisableMultipleSecuritiesQuan.name: Minimum Exercisable Multiple Securities Quantity
MinimumExercisableMultipleSecuritiesQuan.definition: Minimum multiple quantity of financial instrument or lot of rights/warrants that must be exercised.

NewDenominationSecuritiesQuantity.name: New Denomination Securities Quantity
NewDenominationSecuritiesQuantity.definition: New denomination of the financial instrument following, eg, an increase or decrease in nominal value.

NewBoardLotSecuritiesQuantity.name: New Board Lot Securities Quantity
NewBoardLotSecuritiesQuantity.definition: Quantity of equity that makes up the new board lot.

ShareRanking.name: Share Ranking
ShareRanking.definition: Specifies whether the shares are ranking for dividend or pari passu.

AdditionalQuantityForSubscribedResultant.name: Additional Quantity For Subscribed Resultant Securities
AdditionalQuantityForSubscribedResultant.definition: Quantity of additional intermediate securities/new equities awarded for a given quantity of securities derived from subscription.

DateDetails.name: Date Details
DateDetails.definition: Provides information about the dates related to a securities movement.

PriceDetails.name: Price Details
PriceDetails.definition: Provides information about the prices related to a securities movement.

TradingPeriod.name: Trading Period
TradingPeriod.definition: Period during which intermediate securities are tradable in a secondary market.

AdditionalQuantityForExistingSecurities.name: Additional Quantity For Existing Securities
AdditionalQuantityForExistingSecurities.definition: Quantity of additional securities for a given quantity of underlying securities where underlying securities are not exchanged or debited, eg, 1 for 1: 1 new equity credited for every 1 underlying equity = 2 resulting equities.

TemporaryFinancialInstrumentIndicator.name: Temporary Financial Instrument Indicator
TemporaryFinancialInstrumentIndicator.definition: Specifies that the security is a temporary security.

FractionDisposition.name: Fraction Disposition
FractionDisposition.definition: Specifies how fractions resulting from derived securities will be processed or how prorated decisions will be rounding, if provided with a pro ration rate.
